role: Jest snapshot file, written by its spec's toMatchSnapshot calls - generated output, not code.
notes: The snapshot is the output of its spec: its content is not reviewed line by line - a finding about what it records belongs to the spec or the code it renders. Two questions only: where it lies (unit-tests#1), and whether it changed together with what produces it (unit-tests#23).

items.text: Specs live in a `tests/` folder next to the code under test; snapshots in `tests/__snapshots__/`.
Snapshots are updated (`-u`) only after consciously reviewing the diff.
